description: Plans a music video's cuts from a song and its lyrics. It transcribes the song with timestamps ('transcribe', a Whisper-class model) and finds its beats ('beats'), then 'plan_cuts' turns the two into a shot list ('plan') covering the whole song, to the length 'beats' measured. Nothing is generated: the result is one JSON document of shots, each {name, start_frame, num_frames, lead_frames, cut_frames, lyric, kind}, tiling the song exactly at 'fps', so the agent writes one prompt per shot and renders the list with music-video.json, whose entries are {name, prompt, start_frame, num_frames, lead_frames, cut_frames}: add a 'prompt' to each entry and drop 'lyric' and 'kind' to render the plan as it stands. The shots are sized for H3 - 'num_frames' on its 17n+5 grid between 124 and 345 frames, with 'lead_s' seconds of run-up before each cut that music-video trims off - and the result's 'render_frames' is the total frames that will be generated, lead included, for quoting the cost. 'lyrics' is the song's own words, one line per line with a blank line or a lone section tag such as [Chorus] between stanzas: the shots carry those lines verbatim and the transcript only times them, since Whisper mishears sung words. Left null, the shots carry the transcript's text. 'segment_by' is 'line' (a shot per sung line), 'stanza' or 'beat' (a cut every few beats). 'min_scene_s' merges a shot that is too short into its neighbour and 'max_scene_s' splits one that is too long, on a beat. 'vocal_tail_s' holds a sung shot past its last word, 'include_instrumental_gaps' gives a long silence its own instrumental shot, and 'snap_to_beats' moves every cut to its nearest beat. 'timestamps' must stay 'segment' (a Whisper segment per line) or be 'word'; plan_cuts refuses a transcript without timings.
